notes.title: Hotfix v0.2.1
notes.content:
[h1]New feature: Bug Report screen[/h1]

Bugs may occur, but the vital point is how quickly we resolve them. Until now, we’ve asked you to send your save files manually, which can be difficult or problematic for some players. We’ve created an in-game bug report tool so you don’t have to hunt for your save file. From now on, you can share your save file directly from within the game with just one click.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45268850/f23f61919918a1c5428c1fcf5c46b4ca138be796.png[/img]

Just describe the issue and click send. It is that easy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45268850/352c3ec927196f204f8f319221a7534a59b3433e.png[/img]


🐞 Bug Fixes:
[list]
[*] One of the notification localization fixed
[*] Being able to load multiple games causing high contrast view fixed
[/list]

notes.title: Crispy Update 0.2!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45268850/be38576d156dced00d1cf2b31b354e53cd8a2aba.png[/img]

🛠️ Update v0.2 is Live!
We’re excited to roll out Version 0.2, a major update focused on stability, usability, and new gameplay systems. Thank you all for your continued support and feedback — this update wouldn’t be possible without the community!

✅ [b]Fixes[/b]
Fixed a bug where bills were not saved after being paid
Resolved supply chain issue where boxes spawned on the wrong pallets after loading

✨ [b]Improvements[/b]
Improved Recipe Pin Window — now fully controllable without the tablet
Enhanced Rebranding & Interior Customization Panel for smoother interactions

[b]Save System Overhaul:[/b]
🚀 Faster save and load times
🔁 Migrator for legacy saves
📁 Save Slots: Save up to 3 games
💾 Auto Save: Protects your progress from unintended data loss

🆕 New Features
🗨️ Dialog System: Talk with your employees! (Still in development — join our [Discord] to give suggestions!)
🎮 Keyboard Layout Menu: Customize your keybindings for interactions
🧭 New HUD: A fresh, cleaner interface to help you manage your restaurant more effectively
📦Players can now unbox and replace items during the day if the restaurant is closed (previously disabled once the day started)


🔮 Upcoming in v0.3
We’re cooking up something big — literally!
In v0.3, we're completely reworking the kitchen system:

Players will be able to prepare meals
Stock ingredients into dedicated kitchen storage
Build and manage an even more realistic kitchen workflow


Follow us here on Steam and join our for sneak peeks and dev updates as we move toward v0.3!

[url=https://discord.gg/hk6fPppRZA][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45268850/40dbf40be9c95111e0d16c5041202e75ddb1d3a0.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: 🍽️ Post-Release Hotfixes and Updates (v0.1.1 to v0.1.6)
notes.content:
Hey restaurant managers! Since the launch of [b]Restaurant Owner: A Restaurant Simulator[/b], we’ve been working hard to serve up some fresh fixes and polish your gameplay experience. Thanks to your amazing feedback and bug reports, we’ve released several hotfixes addressing critical issues and improving the overall vibe of your restaurant empire.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45268850/35bdaa893ab161c29fc16b0ca732fcc9f2199707.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]🎬 A Quick Note About Our Employees...[/b][/h2]

We know our employees have been acting... a little weird lately 😅 — refusing to work, getting stuck, or just wandering off like it’s their day off. But don’t worry, we’ve been working hard on polishing their AI and making sure they get properly warned when they slack off!

Oh—and if you haven’t seen it yet, we dropped a funny little video where our employees *literally* ask for forgiveness. We think you’ll get a good laugh out of it. Go check it out and let us know what you think! 😄

[previewyoutube=BE1QqLdrAeA;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Let’s take a quick tour through what’s been cooked up so far 🍳[/b]


[h2][b]🧰 v0.1.1 – First Day Fixes[/b][/h2]

This first patch came in hot with crucial bug fixes and a taste of what’s on the horizon.

[h3]🐞 Bug Fixes:[/h3]

- Fixed an issue where the tutorial didn’t properly track completed steps (No more stuck tutorials!)
- Resolved a bug where the tutorial chef had no name (He’s now proudly introduced!)
- Fixed customers getting stuck at the entrance—flow restored!
- Chefs were on strike? Not anymore—they’re cooking again 🍲
- Loan system bugs? Handled.
- Bills now have proper due dates and reminders.

[h3]✨ Improvements:[/h3]

- Employee UI received a visual and functional touch-up
- Chefs now cook with smoother and more natural animations


[h2][b]🚀 v0.1.2 – Quality Control & Clarity[/b][/h2]

The second patch was all about reliability, polish, and making the experience feel tighter and smoother.

[h3]🐞 Bug Fixes:[/h3]

- Chefs are now cooking reliably again (for real this time!)
- Stockers no longer get stuck near trash bins
- Fixed freezer stacking issues
- Two-person groups now sit at appropriate tables (no more hogging four-tops!)
- Fixed double-clicking buttons that triggered actions twice

[h3]✨ Improvements:[/h3]

- Added confirmation prompt to avoid accidentally returning to the main menu
- Restaurant rating is now visible in the UI for a better sense of progress
- **Version compatibility clarified**:
    - ✅ v0.1.1 and v0.1.2 save files are compatible
    - ❌ v0.1.x saves will not be compatible with v0.2.y


[h2][b]🛠️ v0.1.3 – v0.1.6 – Rapid Response Fixes[/b][/h2]

A series of quick patches followed to address urgent reports from the community.

[h3]🐞 Bug Fixes:[/h3]

- Fixed the recurring issue where groups of 2 customers sat at 4-seat tables
- Quick chef behavior fix (again!)
- Fixed rare instances of chefs refusing to cook


[h2]🛠️ What’s Cooking (Preview for Next Patches):[/h2]

- Keyboard layout rebinding
- Auto-save system
- Proper save/load settings handling
- Sound improvements
- More QoL additions on the way!

[h3][b] 🙌 Thank You for the Support![/b][/h3]

We’re overwhelmed with your enthusiasm and detailed feedback. Each patch gets us closer to delivering the smooth, rich restaurant sim experience we’ve envisioned together. Keep sharing your thoughts, screenshots, and ideas—we’re listening!
